    Trial Class

    Welcome to
    UpBeat Music School

    Our talented team of instructors is dedicated to nurturing the musical abilities of each student, offering personalized lessons that inspire and cultivate a lifelong love for music. 

    Trial Class

    Music Classes

    Upbeat Music offers instrumental and vocal courses including guitar, piano, percussion drums, bass, zither, singing/vocal courses, and more! Our instructors average 20+ years of teaching experience.

    ​

    Additionally, we form music bands for both children and adults, and regularly organize master classes and performance activities. This allows the students to be able to practice their learned skills, further enhancing musical skills and interest.

     

    Rent! We have 4 spacious music classrooms, 1 professional band rehearsal room, and 1 medium-sized performance hall. Each teaching venue is equipped with professional stage-level equipment.

    想让您的孩子成为艺术领域的国际新星吗?


    由UNITAR 联合国训练研究所主办，《联合国可持续发展目标与艺术领域拔尖人才计划》正式启动！包括音乐、美术和设计等方面的选拔。中国5个赛区上海，广东，湖南，湖北，山东；现已启动选拔赛。
           Upbeat Music捷拍音乐学校，受到特别邀请，授权负责上海赛区海外赛场音乐类别的选拔/组织/比赛视频录制等相关工作。选拔赛的获奖者可获得联合国官方颁发的获奖证书，并登录国际「艺术顶尖人才库」，可在线查询获奖信息；并有机会走进联合国纽约，维也纳，巴黎等地参加交流演出和艺术成就巡演；对孩子的升学和名校申请履历都有超强助力！
    参赛视频作品投稿，截止时间：2025年7月27日。

     Our Classes

    Guitar

    We offer classical, flamenco, 

    electrical, bass, guitar singing, 

    and all styles of guitar lessons

    Percussion Drums

    Rhythm, technique, and becoming the backbone of a band through hands-on practice.

    Band Ensemble/Performance

    Join a rock band, percussion ensemble, or orchestra to show your talents!

    String Instruments

    Develop proper posture, bowing technique, and finger placement while learning music theory, and play melodies with precision and expression.

    Piano

    Finger technique, hand coordination, and music theory while systematically learning to play melodies, chords, and scales.

    Vocal

    Breath control, pitch accuracy, and vocal techniques while developing range, tone, and expression in singing.

    Band Rehearsal Room For Rent

    We offer a 1,700 square ft space with Wi-Fi, featuring two specially designed Band Practice Places:

    ​

    ✔ A 260 square ft rock band rehearsal room.
    ✔ A 460 square ft band rehearsal stage (also suitable for small music parties and open classes).
    ✔ Fully equipped with a PA system, monitors, guitar amps, a bass amp, Roland keyboard and Yamaha piano, bass guitar, full drum kit, microphones and mic stands, sheet music stands, and cables. Plug and play.
     
    Additionally, we have piano classroom, percussion drum classrooms, guitar and bass classrooms and more available for music teachers.
